title: DealBook Summit 2026: After the Upheaval From the Midterm Elections, Who Has the Edge in 2028?
summary: Are the Democrats’ gains in the midterm elections lasting? Or just another swing of the political pendulum?
caption: The “2026 Midterm Elections” task force discussed the aftermath of the midterms. From left, Stacey Abrams, Alyssa Farah Griffin, David Axelrod, Maggie Haberman, Jonathan Swan, David Urban, Morris Katz and Dan Senor.

title: Prosecutor Urged Justice Dept. to Reconsider Charges Against Fugitive, Email Shows
summary: Aaron Reitz, the U.S. attorney in Houston, questioned the indictment of a Chicago doctor who fled the country after being accused of defrauding taxpayers. The man later donated to Mr. Reitz’s campaign.
caption: Aaron Reitz speaking during a campaign stop in Waco, Texas, when he was running for state attorney general in 2025.

title: Sullivan Concedes Alaska Senate Race to Peltola
summary: The Republican conceded five days after the Trump administration gave up on a long-shot lawsuit intended to potentially block certification of the race.
caption: Senator Dan S. Sullivan said on social media on Tuesday that he would accept the results.
